facts.value: Travel is no longer limited to physical destinations. Today’s traveler seeks story-driven journeys, interactive museums, digital/virtual tourism, themed hotels, and mixed reality tours.

facts.value: Immersive entertainment refers to any form of media or event that deeply involves the participant through sensory, interactive, or spatial engagement.
VR experiences, 360° films, immersive lounges and bars, projection-mapped rooms, LED volumes, escape rooms, interactive dark rides
Its goal is to turn spectators into active participants.
immersive technology solutions, virtual production environments, interactive screens and LED volumes, spatial storytelling tools
